title: Castlevania: The Dracula X Chronicles
subtitle: Richter's journey receives a new presentation
summary: Castlevania: The Dracula X Chronicles is Konami's PSP remake of Rondo of Blood, first released in North America on 23 October 2007. Richter Belmont's adventure uses three-dimensional scenery and characters while retaining side-on platforming and combat. The release also includes unlockable versions of the original Rondo of Blood and Symphony of the Night, bringing the former outside Japan for the first time. Ayami Kojima's character designs give the remake a different visual identity, while revised encounters and obstacles make the journey more than a straightforward replacement of the earlier artwork.
body: Castlevania: The Dracula X Chronicles is Konami's PSP remake of Rondo of Blood, first released in North America on 23 October 2007. Richter Belmont's adventure uses three-dimensional scenery and characters while retaining side-on platforming and combat. The release also includes unlockable versions of the original Rondo of Blood and Symphony of the Night, bringing the former outside Japan for the first time. Ayami Kojima's character designs give the remake a different visual identity, while revised encounters and obstacles make the journey more than a straightforward replacement of the earlier artwork.

The remake adds barriers whose removal depends on rescuing particular characters, connecting exploration to the routes that become available later. Other rescue puzzles are altered, and a redesigned fifth stage introduces the Hydra boss. Saving Annette also affects later encounters and the route to the true ending. The player is therefore encouraged to investigate the stages rather than treat reaching the exit as the only useful outcome. A rescued character can change the structure of a subsequent challenge, making an earlier discovery matter again after the immediate section has been completed.

Koji Igarashi produced the collection, with Akihiro Minakata directing. New voiced scenes can be heard in English or Japanese, while a cooperative Boss Rush uses the PSP's local wireless connection. The unlockable original games let players compare different forms of Castlevania within the same release. The remake preserves the deliberate timing of a side-scrolling action game while reconsidering how its scenes, characters and secrets are presented. Its historical importance also lies in access, finally making Rondo of Blood available internationally alongside the later adventure whose opening returns to the same confrontation.
story_headings: Richter's journey receives a new presentation
Rescuing someone can change the route ahead
A remake also becomes a route into the originals
